scripts.validate: npm run validate:html && npm run validate:css && npm run validate:js
scripts.validate:js: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); const js=html.match(/<script[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g); if(js) { console.log('JavaScript found, manual review needed for syntax errors'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('No JavaScript validation needed'); }"
